gloss: too busy, unable to leave (what one is doing)

definitions.gloss: too busy to stop, unable to step away from work
definitions.explanation: Describes being so occupied with something that one cannot stop or attend to other matters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧{手|て}が{離|はな}せない⟦ん→の：09472_no⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I can't step away right now.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{手|て}が{離|はな}せない。
examples.english: I'm in the middle of cooking and can't leave it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{手|て}が{離|はな}せない。
examples.english: I can't take my hands off the baby.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧{手|て}が{離|はな}せない⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}します→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧。
examples.english: I can't step away right now, so I'll call you back later.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{手|て}が{離|はな}せない⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{行|い}けない→行く：00119_iku⟧。⟦ごめん→御免：00072_gomen⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: I'm tied up before the deadline, so I can't make it to today's drinking party. Sorry.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦{離|はな}せない→離す：19372_hanasu⟧ (cannot release). Literally 'cannot release one's hands' from something.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手|て}が{離|はな}せない: currently occupied, cannot stop
- ⟦{手|て}が{空|あ}く→手が空く：30590_tegaaku⟧: to become free, have free time
- ⟦{手|て}が{足|た}りない→手が足りない：30591_tegatarinai⟧: short-handed, not enough help

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{取|と}り{込|こ}んで→取り込む：05871_torikomu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (busy, occupied)
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{塞|ふさ}がって→塞がる：14872_fusagaru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (hands are full)

USAGE: Common polite way to decline or postpone requests when busy. Less abrupt than simply saying 'busy.'
